newsitem.title: USA: Spelling to sell Virgin Interactive stake.
newsitem.headline: Spelling to sell Virgin Interactive stake.

text.p: Spelling Entertainment Group Inc Thursday said it plans to dispose of its majority interest in Virgin Interactive Entertainment through a public offering.
In a statement, the company said it will report a one-time accounting charge to 1996 earnings as a result of the decision. Spelling did not specify the amount of the charge.

The company said the offering will enable Spelling Entertainment to focus its resources on its core television and feature film production and distribution businesses, thereby enhancing shareholder value.
UBS Securities has been engaged by Spelling Entertainment as its financial adviser in connection with the plan.
Spelling Entertainment Group is a producer and distributor of television, film and interactive entertainment. It is 75 percent owned by Viacom Inc.
